node.name: Receive file from region folder
node.logic: FILE (or SFTP) receive location for each region: ${BBVA_835_PATIENT_FILE_FOLDER}\<REGION>\*.*. Archive component copies the raw file to <REGION>\Archive. EDI disassembler splits the interchange into one message for each ST transaction set and resolves the BBVA schema through party agreement BBVA_To_SmileDoctors.
